title: Vice President, Global Accounting
text:
About Lyra Health
Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. 


Responsibilities
Corporate Accounting & Financial Reporting

•

Provide leadership and oversight across corporate accounting, general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, lease accounting, consolidations, and related accounting operations.

•

Lead consolidated financial reporting ensuring timely and accurate financial results in accordance with U.S. GAAP .

•

Establish and maintain accounting policies, governance, and processes and lead the evaluation and implementation of new accounting standards.

•

Deliver meaningful financial information and insights to support executive decision-making.

Public Company & SOX Readiness

•

Support the design and implementation of a scalable SOX compliance framework, including strong business-process controls, governance, documentation, and accountability.

•

Strengthen the accounting organization’s infrastructure across close and consolidation, SEC-quality financial reporting, accounting policies, technical accounting, internal controls, systems, documentation, and audit readiness.

Accounting Operations & Transformation

•

Lead the standardization and optimization of accounting processes globally, establishing clear ownership, performance expectations, service levels, and measurable outcomes.

•

Champion continuous improvement and identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, simplify processes, accelerate cycle times, and improve the quality and accessibility of financial information.

•

Bring a technology-forward mindset to Accounting, identifying opportunities to leverage automation, AI, standardized workflows, and modern financial systems to improve speed, accuracy, scalability, controls, and insight.

Treasury & Cash Management

•

Strengthen processes supporting cash visibility, liquidity management, cash positioning, and working capital optimization.

•

Develop recommendations that support effective capital deployment, liquidity management, and financial risk management.

Leadership & Business Partnership

•

Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing accounting organization building organizational depth, leadership capability, accountability, and opportunities for professional growth.

•

Create an environment that attracts, develops, engages, and retains exceptional accounting talent.

•

Build strong partnerships to drive alignment and successfully execute cross-functional initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will mean building upon Lyra’s accounting foundation and transforming the organization for its next stage of growth. This leader will help create:

•

A scalable, high-performing global accounting organization with strong leadership depth and clear accountability.

•

A faster, more predictable, and increasingly automated financial close.

•

Standardized global accounting processes supported by strong systems, data, and controls.

•

Financial reporting and accounting infrastructure capable of operating at public-company standards.

•

A robust and sustainable SOX and internal-control environment.

•

Greater use of technology, automation, and AI across accounting workflows.

•

An accounting organization recognized as a trusted, strategic partner to the business.

Qualifications
•

Strong executive presence and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex issues, resolve escalations, and drive alignment across functions.

•

15+ years of progressive accounting experience with demonstrated success leading and developing complex accounting organizations in a global environment.

•

Public-company accounting experience; a deep understanding of U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting requirements, SOX and audit requirements.

•

Demonstrated success leading accounting transformation, process standardization, automation, and continuous-improvement initiatives.

•

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA required.

•

A collaborative, pragmatic leadership style and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, high-growth environment.

"We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information or any other category protected by law.
 
By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your personal information will be processed as per the Lyra Health Workforce Privacy Notice. Through this application, to the extent permitted by law, we will collect personal information from you including, but not limited to, your name, email address, gender identity, employment information, and phone number for the purposes of recruiting and assessing suitability, aptitude, skills, qualifications, and interests for employment with Lyra.  We may also collect information about your race, ethnicity, and sexual orientation, which is considered sensitive personal information under the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) and special category data under the UK and EU GDPR.  Providing this information is optional and completely voluntary, and if you provide it you consent to Lyra processing it for the purposes as described at the point of collection, for example for diversity and inclusion initiatives.  If you are a California resident and would like to limit how we use this information, please use the Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information form.  This information will only be retained for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, as described above. Please note that Lyra does not “sell” or “share” personal information as defined by the CPRA. Outside of the United States, for example in the EU, Switzerland and the UK, you may have the right to request access to, or a copy of, your personal information, including in a portable format; request that we delete your information from our systems; object to or restrict processing of your information; or correct inaccurate or outdated personal information in our systems. These rights may be subject to legal limitations. To exercise your data privacy rights outside of the United States, please contact globaldpo@lyrahealth.com. For more information about how we use and retain your information, please see our Workforce Privacy Notice."
